name: ElevenLabs voice
description: ElevenLabs text to speech for Odysseus: your account's voices, a credit reserve, and Kokoro or the browser voice when credits run low.
author: Jaron Wilson

steps.title: ElevenLabs voices for Odysseus
steps.body: This add-on lets Odysseus read replies aloud and speak in voice calls with **ElevenLabs** voices, including your own cloned voices. The local Kokoro voice stays built in and takes over when ElevenLabs is paused.

steps.title: Add your API key
steps.body:
Paste an ElevenLabs API key on this page (create one at elevenlabs.io under *Developers > API keys*). It is checked with ElevenLabs and kept on the server only; the page shows just its last four characters.

Already had a key in Odysseus before this add-on? Import it instead, see the README (*Moving your key from Odysseus*).

steps.title: Pick it as the voice
steps.body: In Odysseus, open *Settings > AI Defaults > Voice call* and set **Speaks with** to *ElevenLabs voice (add-on)*. The voice list then shows your account's voices.

steps.title: Save credits
steps.body: ElevenLabs bills per character. **Keep in reserve** stops using it below a share of your plan, and **Max per reply** caps how much of one reply is read aloud. A repeated phrase is cached and costs nothing.
